accuracy.evidence: Checked against AQA 7404/7405 specification 3.3.6.1 (identification of functional groups by test-tube reactions) and Required Practical 6, OCR A H432 carbonyl tests (2,4-DNP, Tollens'), and the RSC Practical Chemistry test-tube reaction notes. Observations match: bromine water orange to colourless (C=C); NaHCO₃ effervescence with CO₂ that turns limewater cloudy (–COOH only, not alcohols); warm acidified dichromate(VI) orange to green Cr³⁺ for 1° and 2° alcohols and aldehydes, no change for 3°; Tollens' silver mirror only for aldehydes; 2,4-DNP orange precipitate for aldehydes and ketones. Stoichiometry items use RCHO : Ag = 1 : 2 and one CO₂ per –COOH.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets documented A-level errors: green dichromate taken as proof of an alcohol (step 1 prediction, m3), 'no change means no functional group' (step 2 prediction, m9, challenge tag none), 'clear' for 'colourless' (observation row, m1, tag clear), Tollens' confused with Fehling's brick-red (observation row, m4), alcohols expected to fizz with carbonate (tag oh, m2, p4 with 2-hydroxypropanoic acid), and one group masking another (step 5 prediction, m6).

lab_distinct.evidence: flagfgtest is a qualitative-analysis lab: a reagent × liquid result grid, look-alike liquids named from a pattern of positives and negatives, a mystery-liquid hunt scored by tests used, and +/– predictions for molecules with two groups. flagbrw models bromine uptake by one C=C, flagalcox classifies alcohols and oxidation products, flagfgroup names groups from structures. Shingle gate: 6.6% vs flagalcox, under 1% vs flagbrw, flagcooh and flagfgroup.

lab_teaches.evidence: The grid makes propanal turn dichromate green next to propan-1-ol, so the learner sees why green is not proof of an alcohol. In step 2 propanone and 2-methylpropan-2-ol give identical dichromate and Tollens' results, so only 2,4-DNP can separate them. A wrong suspect in the mystery step gets the exact test that rules it out ('Tollens' rules that out: ethanol would show no change, but this one gives a silver mirror') or the next useful test ('No test so far tells those apart. Try Tollens'.').

predictions.evidence: Three locked predictions with tempting wrong answers that the next task disproves: 'Only propan-1-ol: it is the alcohol test' (propanal also turns green), 'It has no functional group' (propanone gives an orange 2,4-DNP precipitate), and 'One: the stronger group hides the other' (prop-2-enoic acid is positive with both bromine water and NaHCO₃). A.reveal quotes the learner's guess in each done line.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Six rotating challenge questions; hint() returns a specific m= correction for each tag: dnp (2,4-DNP cannot split aldehyde from ketone), br, oh, none, tert, mix (which reagent gives which colour) and clear. Wrong taps inside the lab name the slip through the observation-row messages, why() and the check() mismatch message.

readability.evidence: Learner text FK 5.5 against the target 6.5, in short sentences that keep the exact reagent names. Adult text FK 9.5 against 9.5 and uses the specification terms: reagent, conditions, observation, effervescence, electrophilic addition, oxidise, reduced to Cr³⁺, [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺, 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone, carbonyl.

no_filler.evidence: Filler and overlap gates passed. Learner paragraphs cover the idea of a positive test, the C=C and –COOH tests, the oxidation and carbonyl tests, and how to read negatives and word observations. Adult paragraphs give the specification link, the chemistry of each test, five named mistakes and the lab outline.

mobile.evidence: iPhone 13 screenshots in light and dark for all six steps before and after Show me: the 4 × 4 result grid keeps tubes and result words readable at 390 px; compound names wrap at hyphens (2-methyl-/propan-2-ol); the mystery step's five suspect chips wrap 3 + 2; two-group cells show ✓/✗ with the real result. phone_sweep for lesson 407 reported 0 findings.

accessibility.evidence: walk.cjs (gate_browser) passed on desktop and iPhone 13: all five Show me tasks completed, challenge reached, axe clean in both themes, no console errors. Every canvas tap has a button twin (Add reagent, Name liquid, observation choices, Test with, It is, +/– per test, Run tests), and desktop tap tests confirmed the canvas aria-label carries each result and correction.
